text:
Carmen Lee: Heads-up — AtlasEdge (reseller) proposed a milestone-based onboarding: total commit $150,000 split into 3 milestone payments ($50k at sign, $50k at pilot start, $50k at go-live). They want a sliding rev-share: 20% during pilot, 12% post-go-live. Also asking for a 25% one-time reseller discount applied to the pilot invoice only. Request net-30 invoices and monthly payouts. Need finance + legal approval for reserve treatment, GL mapping, and early-termination clawback. cc @Owen Patel @Grace Yu

Owen Patel: Clarifying Qs — is this hosted? payment method? how do they define pilot vs go-live (milestone criteria)? Need infra COGS to run margin-impact and a recommendation for reserve %.

Carmen Lee: Hosted API. Payment by ACH. Milestone criteria are in SOW: pilot start = first active customer >1 core app; go-live = 3 paying customers onboarded. They'll wire sign payment within 5 business.

Grace Yu: Infra run-rate sim shows COGS ~ $32k across the contract lifecycle (excludes PS integration ~ $6k if requested). Sliding rev-share looks ok, but we should avoid paying partner more than gross margin in early months. Suggest reserve 30% of each milestone into a reseller_liability account until reconciliation.

Carmen Lee: Also AtlasEdge asks that rev-share be computed on net after platform transaction fees and VAT treatment depends on customer's region (they're EU-based). They request Redwood handle VAT gross-up on our invoices.

LegalBot: Legal flags — need addendum to reseller agreement capturing milestone definitions, rev-share calc (net after fees), VAT responsibilities, KYC/tax forms, and an explicit clawback on early termination within first 12 months (prorated refund of paid rev-share above the allowed cap). I can draft language once finance locks reserve policy.

Owen Patel: Finance guardrails proposal: (1) require proof of wire before provisioning pilot seats; (2) reserve 30% of each milestone into GL 5202 (reseller_milestone_hold); (3) cap cumulative rev-share payouts to 40% of gross margin across first 6 months; (4) do not gross-up for VAT — AtlasEdge must provide VAT invoice details; if they insist Redwood will net the VAT and treat as contra-revenue.

Grace Yu: Confirmed COGS and cap suggestion. For PS risk, add an integration line item in the SOW to be deducted from milestone if not prepaid separately.

Carmen Lee: AtlasEdge accepted milestone plan and sliding rev-share conditional on treasury approval for reserve. They've agreed to provide VAT registration and KYC immediately. I'll attach SOW and wire proof to the billing ticket.

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-5107: "AtlasEdge milestone prepaid & sliding rev-share" — tasks: create plan_id 'atlasedge-milestone-v1', invoice template supporting milestone lines and contra-revenue VAT handling, GL mapping 5202 for reseller_milestone_hold. Link: https://redwood.internal/billing/BILL-5107

Owen Patel: Treasury provisional: exposure per milestone <$75k so net-30 OK with reserve 30% per milestone. Approving: 25% pilot one-time discount applied to pilot invoice, sliding rev-share 20% pilot / 12% post-go-live, net-30, monthly payouts, reserve 30% into GL 5202, clawback language required in addendum. :white_check_mark:

LegalBot: I'll draft addendum and include VAT/withholding language and the clawback formula (prorated based on months remaining). Carmen, please attach SOW + wiring proof to BILL-5107 and ping Partnerships for final sign-off.

Carmen Lee: Will attach docs now and loop Partnerships. billing-bot please tag plan 'atlasedge-milestone-v1' and set priority high for billing config. Thanks team :v:
